messages:
tara: FYI rolling a small canary for llm-routing tonight in the 02:00 UTC change window. We'll open feature flag route_slice_night to 0.25% for a 12m soak, then 3% for 18m, then 15% if all gates pass. Includes a fallback priority tweak and small kernel patch. @leo @maria please ack. :crescent_moon:

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: llm-routing @ 02:00 UTC. Auto-schedule: 0.25% (12m) -> 3% (18m) -> 15% (manual-check). Health ping cadence 25s. Will post to #eng-releases-canary.

leo: ack. Recommend model pin to v3.1-qt-lite for the canary only. v3.2-quant still going through QA.

tara: OK pin v3.1-qt-lite. Adding to deploy metadata.
maria: safety gates proposal: - errorRate > 0.6% for 5m -> rollback - p95 increase > +220ms -> hold and manual review - DB throttle alarm -> immediate hold. Also prefer 60s cohort drain on rollback.

ops-anne: Pre-warm suggestion: bootstrap warm caches and primed KV for 6m. If rollback happens, run cache-warm on stable nodes after cutover. Also set alert routing to notify oncall via SMS.

tara: internal command to start the slice (for runbook):
```
infra flag set route_slice_night --cohort 0.0025 --stage soak --pin model=v3.1-qt-lite --meta \"change_window:night;deploy:6254321000\"
```

maria: added to release notes draft: \"route_slice_night warmup; pinned v3.1-qt-lite; rollback gates: err>0.6% / p95>+220ms / DB throttle\". Who's primary oncall?

leo: I'll take primary. @ops-anne backup. I'll keep the low-latency dashboard up and enable the p95/p99 alert thresholds for the window.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 6254321025. Health pings active (25s).

tara: first 6m telemetry: error rate 0.09%, p95 +80ms, p99 +160ms. All green. Planning to scale to 3% at +12m if stable. :thumbsup:

maria: noted. Publishing customer-facing blurb after canary passes 2nd stage.

leo: watching. If I see p95 trend > +220ms for 5m or error spikes, I'll flip the flag off and pin routing to stable. Will run postmortem if we need rollback.

ops-anne: Reminder: if rollback triggers, set cohort-drain=60s and run cache warmup on stable group to avoid cold starts.
